title: Endaoment
tagline: Endaoment is a project to help DAOs manage budget allocation to proposed projects
description:
This project creates a dapp where member of a DAO can come and allocate funds to the project based on the project roadmap and completed milestones instead of just giving unvetted projects and founders a lump sum of project budget upfront with no guarantees. It creates an anti rug pull mechanism for the funders and creates accountability for the creators.

Step 1: The DAO team creates a project to be funded

Step 2: DAO members stake the funds for the project

Step 3: At each milestone DAO members fund the next step automatically if milestones are met

if not they can vote to stop funding and return funds or to continue anyway

Step 4: Repeat Step 3 until all objectives are met and milestones have been completed!

Step 5: Celebrate the project should be launched and live now!
how_its_made:
